subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new pinned `openai/codex-action` revision in workflows that provide an OpenAI API key after an explicit revision-level trust audit?
rationale: The upgrade changes a credential-bearing third-party action boundary; repository policy requires direct Codex contract inspection, which was not available in this read-only sandbox.

options.title: Audit and retain the update
options.body: Verify the v1.11 action contract and its API-key handling, then merge with redacted successful workflow evidence.

options.title: Split out Codex action updates
options.body: Keep the other action upgrades separate and hold the Codex action bump for a dedicated security review.

recommendation.title: Audit and retain the update
recommendation.body: Verify the v1.11 action contract and its API-key handling, then merge with redacted successful workflow evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline identifies this person as a subscriber to the CI workflow update, but ownership evidence is limited without local history.
